#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Generate CSV with header id,cat,val; N rows, deterministic.
import sys, random
n = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 2000000
random.seed(42)
cats = ["cat%02d" % i for i in range(50)]
out = sys.stdout
out.write("id,cat,val\n")
lines = []
for i in range(n):
    lines.append("%d,%s,%.3f\n" % (i, cats[random.randrange(50)], random.uniform(-1000, 1000)))
    if len(lines) >= 100000:
        out.write("".join(lines)); lines = []
out.write("".join(lines))
